Find information about disciplinary actions taken by the Board against licensed chiropractors. These actions may result from various issues, such as violations of professional standards, misconduct, or breaches of the state's chiropractic laws and regulations. By accessing this information, the public can be aware of actions taken to ensure the integrity of chiropractic services in South Dakota.
